title: Missing moeb tool: Read (oversized tool result)
description: Used Claude Code Read tool to read start_spec output saved to disk (161KB+) after exceeding MCP inline result limit. No moeb tool exists for reading harness-persisted oversized output artifacts.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool or kernel mechanism for streaming or paginating oversized tool outputs so agents need not fall back to the external Read tool.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
